◆ Market Overview

Futures are mixed with a slight defensive tilt - VIX down to 25.34 but still elevated above comfort levels. The Dow's modest +0.27% gain against NASDAQ's -0.22% drop signals rotation into value ahead of key Fed commentary. Pre-market action is muted but Iran-US diplomatic progress is the dominant macro theme driving energy weakness.

◆ What to Watch

  • Fed Logan Speech (8:00 AM): High-impact event that could shift rate expectations with markets already on edge
  • ADP Weekly Employment (12:15 PM): First look at labor momentum heading into Friday's jobs report
  • MBA Mortgage Data (11:00 AM): Housing demand indicators amid rate uncertainty - watch refinance index closely
  • Iran-US Negotiations: Any headlines on Hormuz shipping agreement will move energy and broader risk assets
⚡ Key Driver
Iran deal progress could break oil below $89 and trigger broad energy sector selling while boosting consumer discretionary names on lower input costs.

◆ Sector Rotation

Clear flight to defensive consumer plays - staples (+1.48%) and discretionary (+1.44%) leading while energy (-1.37%) and tech (-0.58%) lag. This rotation screams "late cycle" positioning as traders hedge growth concerns. Healthcare's +0.53% gain adds to the defensive narrative while financials remain under pressure at -0.41%.
✦ Bull Case
Amazon's AI retail licensing could spark broader enterprise AI monetization theme. Consumer strength in XLY/XLP suggests spending resilience despite macro headwinds.
⚠ Bear Case
Tech weakness with elevated VIX above 25 suggests institutional selling isn't done. Energy sector breakdown could signal broader commodity deflation concerns.

◆ Levels That Matter

  • SPY $747: Pre-market low - break triggers test of $740 support zone
  • QQQ $725: Critical technical level - failure here opens $715 gap fill
  • XLE $85: Energy sector breakdown level if Iran headlines accelerate
  • VIX 27: Upside trigger that would signal broader risk-off move

Not a prediction. A preparation. Make your plan before the bell.
